thread:
Marta: Quick sync — AuroraHealth customer spotlight. Need to lock interview slots, get quote approvals from their CEO + eng lead, and confirm legal embargo. Also thinking a short benchmark blurb to include in the launch post + webinar. Can we make legal ok by Mon?

Devon: I can wrangle scheduling. Suggest 30m remote slots Wed 10–12 or Thu 2–5 PST. @marta which slot do you prefer for the CEO? I can add Calendly if that helps. :calendar:

Liam: Re: benchmark blurb — we can run a small throughput snapshot on their sample prompt set. 30min job on staging, should give Ops vs baseline numbers. If approved, we can include a single-line stat like "2.5x latency reduction at 4k tokens" and link to a short appendix. Need their signoff to run test.

Ana: Heads-up on lead routing: if we publish and run the webinar, inbound signups should go to Enterprise SDRs. Please add utm_campaign=aurora_launch and tag leads with "aurora-case" so ops can route. Also ask CS to confirm Aurora is OK with us routing sales leads.

Sophie: For assets I need: 1) pull quote (finalized), 2) 2 headshots (CEO + Eng lead), 3) 3 short soundbites for social (15s). Can we get those within 48h of interview? I can mock social frames before legal clears copy.

Marta: Copy for quote below (paste into thread so legal has it):
```
"Redwood's latency improvements let us serve real-time clinical summaries without compromising accuracy. That change alone unlocked a 40% increase in clinician throughput."
```

legal-bot: Thanks — please attach the full interview transcript and any imagery to the case folder. Quick notes on copy: avoid absolute performance claims without attribution; recommend adding "in our tests" or linking to the benchmark appendix. Typical review window: 48–72h for copy + 3–5 business days if customers request redlines.

Marta: Updated quote per legal suggestion: "In our tests, Redwood's latency improvements let us serve real-time clinical summaries without compromising accuracy, helping increase clinician throughput." Can legal confirm?

legal-bot: Quick redline: replace "without compromising accuracy" with "while maintaining clinical accuracy" (clarity + less absolute). Also confirm any PHI-related examples are removed. Otherwise looks fine. :white_check_mark:

Ana: Aurora says they're comfortable with lead routing but need a short consent blurb on the webinar form. I'll draft. Also they asked for an embargo until the 10th (internal launch coordination).

Devon: Ok — embargo 10th. Action items: I’ll send Calendly loop for Wed/Thu and lock CEO slot for Wed 10:30 PST tentatively. @liam please confirm test window by EOD so we can run benchmark Thu morning. @sophie hold the mockups until quote is final. @legal-bot mark copy as priority review.

Liam: Confirmed — benchmark job scheduled Thu 09:00 PST on staging. Will post results here with a single-line stat + appendix link.

Sophie: Noted. Will prep draft social frames and one hero image option. Need final quote + headshots to finish.

Marta: Thanks team — I'll add the final quote and request headshots in the calendar invite. syncing on results here. :thumbsup:

Devon: I'll also update the webinar landing page with UTM params and the lead routing tag. Draft CTA: "See how AuroraHealth scaled clinician throughput — join our launch webinar."

Marta: Perfect. Leaving task list: schedule interviews (Devon), run benchmark (Liam), legal signoff on final language (legal-bot), confirm lead consent & form copy (Ana), assets & social drafts (Sophie). Will follow up Mon AM for status.

legal-bot: Noted, priority flag set. Please ping if customer requests edits; otherwise we should be green by Mon close assuming no external redlines.

Ana: I'll prep the webinar consent blurb and share in thread by EOD.

Marta: Closing the loop — thanks everyone.
